title: Identification and in silico analysis of novel antioxidant peptides in broken rice protein hydrolysate and its cytoprotective effect against H(2)O(2)-induced 2BS cell model.
authors: Ren, Li-Kun; Yang, Yang; Ma, Chun-Min; Fan, Jing; Bian, Xin; Liu, Bao-Xiang; Wang, Dang-Feng; Zhu, Peng-Yu; Fu, Yu; Zhang, Na
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦碎米蛋白水解物中抗氧化肽的鉴定及其细胞保护作用，虽含分子对接但对象为肽-蛋白（Keap1）互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Broken rice is an important by-product during milling process of rice, which is rich in protein. To increase the value of by-products and search for effective antioxidants, the antioxidant peptides from broken rice protein hydrolysate were separated and identified by ultrafiltration, gel filtration chromatography, fast protein liquid chromatography, and LC-MS/MS in this study. These identified peptides were further screened using a combined in silico and in vitro method and their antioxidant mechanism was explored by Western blot and molecular docking analysis. Ninety-eight peptides were obtained after antioxidant activity-oriented isolation and four novel peptides, SGDWSDIGGR, DFGSEILPR, GEPFPSDPKKQLQ, and GEKGGIPIGIGK, with excellent solubility, safety, and antioxidant activity were synthesized. Among these, SGDWSDIGGR showed good antioxidant activities in the extracellular assay (41.57 mumol TE/g and 29.41 % in ORAC and DPPH assay, respectively.), and it possessed a protective effect against H(2)O(2)-injured oxidative stress in 2BS cells in a dose-dependent manner. Furthermore, Western blot and molecular docking results showed that SGDWSDIGGR achieves antioxidant ability by occupying the Nrf2-binding site, activating the Keap1-Nrf2 signaling pathway, and upregulating the expression of antioxidant enzymes. This study extends the rice industry chain and provides insights into the selection and mechanisms research of antioxidant peptides.
abstract_zh: 碎米是稻米加工过程中的重要副产物，富含蛋白质。为提高副产物价值并寻找有效抗氧化剂，本研究通过超滤、凝胶过滤色谱、快速蛋白液相色谱和LC-MS/MS对碎米蛋白水解物中的抗氧化肽进行了分离和鉴定。这些鉴定出的肽进一步通过结合计算机模拟和体外方法进行筛选，并利用Western blot和分子对接分析探讨了其抗氧化机制。经抗氧化活性导向分离后获得98种肽，并合成了四种具有优异溶解性、安全性和抗氧化活性的新型肽：SGDWSDIGGR、DFGSEILPR、GEPFPSDPKKQLQ和GEKGGIPIGIGK。其中，SGDWSDIGGR在细胞外实验中表现出良好的抗氧化活性（ORAC和DPPH测定分别为41.57 μmol TE/g和29.41%），并对H(2)O(2)诱导的2BS细胞氧化应激具有剂量依赖性保护作用。此外，Western blot和分子对接结果表明，SGDWSDIGGR通过占据Nrf2结合位点、激活Keap1-Nrf2信号通路并上调抗氧化酶表达来实现其抗氧化能力。本研究延伸了稻米产业链，并为抗氧化肽的选择及机制研究提供了见解。
